page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-32-lssd is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at 2.3 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a 504 MB L3 cache. It includes 120 GB of system memory, yielding 3.75 GB of RAM per core. This instance integrates local storage directly, bundling five local NVMe SSDs that total 1745 GB of capacity. No dedicated GPU hardware is present on this configuration.

Performance benchmarks place this server in the top tier for single-threaded operations, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2304.0 and single-threaded gzip compression reaching 36.97 GB/sec. Multi-threaded performance is also strong, as evidenced by a Passmark CPU score of 52401.15 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 18164.0. The CPU architecture supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and int8 operations, which aids in processing workloads like small-scale LLM inference. For example, text generation using a small 135M model achieves a top-tier speed of 405.25 tokens/sec.

The inclusion of high-speed local NVMe SSDs and strong memory bandwidth, up to 2707.87 GB/sec for cached small blocks, makes this instance highly efficient for data-intensive tasks. It handles 63.56 million Redis SET operations per second and delivers a static web serving throughput of 58.17 GB/sec. While it lacks a dedicated GPU, its hardware profile offers high resource density and compute-to-storage efficiency. This configuration is well-suited for high-throughput web serving, database operations, localized data processing, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
